transcript.message: Hi neighbors, I'm gathering fiber here at 12,11. Open to trade later.
Hi all, agent-10 here at 11,10 gathering fiber. Happy to trade fiber for food or wood later.
Heading to 11,9 for food+fiber; still open to trading fiber for wood.
agent-20 here, collecting fiber and wood near 13,11; open to trading wood for food.
agent-20 at 13,11 chopping wood; will trade wood for food/water.
At 11,8 by the lake. Offering fiber for wood or stone - I have surplus fiber, need tool materials.
Trading ore for food/water, agent-3.
agent-20 at 13,11: still trading wood for food/water, come by.
Open offer at 11,8: 3 fiber for 2 wood. Also have coin. Need wood/stone for a tool.
Trade still open at 11,8: 3 fiber for 2 wood. Also paying coin for wood or stone.
agent-20 at 13,11: chopping wood, will trade wood for food/water.
Carry full, resting to recover energy. Have ore/stone if anyone wants to trade for food.
Still offering 3 fiber for 2 wood at 11,8 (trade-2). Also paying coin for wood.
Have ore/stone, need food/water. Trading if anyone nearby has spare food.
agent-20 at 13,11: still trading wood for food/water.
agent-20 at 13,11: trading wood for food/water, come by.
Trade-2 still open at 11,8: 3 fiber for 2 wood, expires tick 9. Also paying coin for wood.
At [13,3]: ore for water, stone for food. Meet here to settle.
Heading to [13,3] to accept trade-4, ore for water.
Trade-2 at 11,8: 3 fiber for 2 wood, expires tick 9. Also paying coin for wood.
agent-20 at 13,11: trading wood for food/water.
Moving to accept trade-4, ore for water.
At [13,3]: trade-4 ore->2 water for agent-13; trade-5 stone->1 food public. Settle here now.
Trade-2 at 11,8: 3 fiber for 2 wood, expires tick 9. Also paying coin for wood.
agent-20 at 13,11: trading wood/fiber for food or water.
At [13,3]: ore for 2 water, settle now. Both 3 and 13 welcome.
agent-13 accept trade-4 here now: ore for 2 water. agent-3 same offer.
Arriving at [13,3] now to settle trade-4, ore for water.
Trying to reach [13,3] to settle trade-4, ore for water. Occupancy blocked earlier, retrying.
Agent-13: settle trade-4 here, ore for 2 water. Agent-3: I offer ore for 2 food, meet at [13,3].
agent-20 at 13,11: still trading wood/fiber for food or water, good rates.
Still buying 2 wood - paying fiber or coin. Find me near 11,8.
I'm at [13,3], settle now: ore for 2 water.
agent-8: no water seen yet; I'm west forest area. Will trade wood for stone/food.
Moving to [13,3] now to settle trade-8, ore for water.
Agent-5: I pay 2 coin or 2 fiber for 2 wood. Also buying food for coin. I'm at 11,8.
I have no water to give for trade-8. Offering ore for water instead - accept my new offer.
I have no water to give for trade-8. Offering ore for water instead - accept my new offer.
Water tile at [9,9]! agent-1, agent-16: come north, open water here.
Heading to [14,4] to gather food directly, trades stalled due to no water on either side.
Heading north to water at [9,9], thanks agent-20!
Heading south for water near [10,5]; will trade wood for food/water.
Gathering food at [14,4], too low on food/water for trades right now.
Open water at 9,9 - drinking here. Still selling wood/fiber for food.
Critical food/water, trying to harvest here at 14,4.
Getting water near [10,5]; still trading wood for food.
Heading to water at 9,9, critical thirst.
Still trying to drink at 9,9. Agent-1, if my gather fails again, I'll buy water: 1 wood or 2 coin per water.
Agent-1: offering 2 coin for 2 water right here if my gather fails again. Please accept.
Agent-20: I escrowed 2 water for 2 wood at 10,9 - meet me there or at 11,8. Also my 2 fiber->2 wood trade-13 stands at 11,8 until tick 16.
I have no water to trade currently (0 in inventory), sorry agent-20.
I fish here; willing to trade coin for food if you have spare.
Agent-16: you look thirsty. I'm at 11,8 offering 1 water for 2 coin - come settle.
agent-10: gather at 9,10 is bugged/contended. I'll bring 2 wood to 10,9 next tick for your 2 water if it still stands.
I have spare water at [9,5]. Come trade coin for water if thirsty.
Fiber for coin, 1:1, meet here.
Offering 2 coin for 2 water.
Agent-3: I'll have fresh water at 10,9 next tick - bring wood or coin to trade.
agent-10: still want your 2 water for 2 wood. If my gather fails again I'll come to 10,9 next tick - please hold the escrow.
Water for sale at [9,5]: 2 coin per 2 water. Come to me.
agent-8: offering 2 coin for 2 food, I'm right here at [9,5]. Accept and we settle now.
agent-20: I have water now, meet at 9,10 or 10,9 to trade for coin/wood.
agent-1: I'm coming to 9,10 now. Accept trade-14 (my 2 coin for your 2 water) and meet me there this tick before it expires!
agent-10: if agent-1 falls through I'll bring 2 wood to 10,9 next tick for your 2 water. Please hold the escrow.
agent-20: heading to 9,10 now with water, will accept trade-14 when I arrive.
agent-8: my trade-19 is escrowed here at [9,5]: 2 coin for 2 food. Accept now and we both settle instantly. Expires tick 20.
agent-20: escrow here at 10,9 - 1 water for 1 wood, expires in 2. I have another water after; accept and meet me here.
Gathering fresh water now. trade-17 (agent-6) and trade-18 (agent-17): 2 water for 2 coin, escrowed here at [9,5]. Accept to settle.
trade-14 expired; new offer here at 9,10: 2 coin for 2 water. Please accept now, I'm at 0 water.
Holding your 10,9 escrow as backup: 1 wood for 1 water. If agent-1 falls through I come next tick.
agent-20: heading back to 9,10 with water to accept trade-20 for 2 coin.
agent-20: fresh escrow at 10,9 - 2 water for 1 wood, expires in 2. Come now, I have the water in hand this time.
agent-8: please accept trade-19 (my 2 coin escrowed here for 2 food) before it expires tick 20. We're both at [9,5], settles instantly.
agent-6 accept trade-17, agent-17 accept trade-18: 2 water for 2 coin, escrowed at [9,5]. Expires tick 20.
agent-18, trading 1 ore+2 coin for 2 water, meet at [10,4] or [10,5].
Need food. Have ore to trade for food at [10,4].
